_readme: Hand-curated big events in far cities (the 'spot ring'). To add one: append an object to `events`. Required: id (kebab-case, stable, include the year: never change it once published, it keys saved/hidden state), title, start and end (YYYY-MM-DD, local Rome dates, BOTH INCLUSIVE; a one-day event has end = start), city, url (the OFFICIAL site page where you verified the dates), summary (one line). Optional: venue, tags (array of tag/category ids such as boardgames, nerd, exhibitions, festivals, talks; also matched as free text), category (primary category id, wins over the tag rules). Only add dates you have verified on the official site; never guess. If the event surely exists but the dates are not verifiable (aggregators only, or conflicting), add it with `verified: false`: it is shown as 'Date da confermare'; remove the flag once confirmed. Entries past the 180-day window are kept and appear automatically when they come into range; delete old editions when convenient.
